$comment: Frictionless Table Schema (https://specs.frictionlessdata.io/table-schema/). Tab-separated, UTF-8, one header row; columns appear in this order.
name: immonium
title: immonium.tsv
description: Immonium-ion evidence for each reported PSM, in the order of results.sage.parquet. Written only when `immonium` is enabled.

fields.name: psm_id
fields.description: PSM identifier, as in the `psm_id` column of results.sage.parquet.

fields.name: scannr
fields.description: Native spectrum identifier, as in the `scannr` column of results.sage.parquet.

fields.name: is_decoy
fields.description: Whether the PSM is a decoy.

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Rank of the PSM within its spectrum.

fields.name: explained
fields.description: Residue immonium ions (P, V, L/I, H, F, Y, W) observed whose unmodified residue is in the peptide.

fields.name: missing
fields.description: Residue immonium ions the peptide's unmodified residues give that are not observed; ions below the lowest retained peak are not counted.

fields.name: unexplained
fields.description: Residue immonium ions observed whose unmodified residue is not in the peptide.

fields.name: residue_ions
fields.description: Comma-separated labels of the residue ions observed; empty when none.

fields.name: modified_explained
fields.description: Configured modified-residue ions observed whose modified residue is in the peptide.

fields.name: modified_unexplained
fields.description: Configured modified-residue ions observed whose modified residue is not in the peptide.

fields.name: modified_ions
fields.description: Comma-separated names of the modified-residue ions observed; empty when none.
